Name: Deluxe Journal Continued
Author: kauf0
Description:
[size=3][size=5][b]DELUXE JOURNAL (CONTINUED)[/b][/size]
This is a community fork of Deluxe Journal by MolsonCAD, continued with bugfixes. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Original mod[/url][/size]

[size=3]Deluxe Journal upgrades the in-game journal, adding new features for keeping track of the day-to-day. Create a to-do list of tasks with various auto-completion conditions, or jot down what you need on the notes page.[/size]

[size=4][b][u]INSTALL[/u][/b][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the [url=https://smapi.io/]latest version of SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]Install this mod from Nexus mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip into the StardewValley/Mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]REQUIREMENTS[/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Stardew Valley 1.6[/size] 
[*][size=3]SMAPI version 4.0+[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]FEATURES[/u][/b][/size][size=3][b]
Tasks Page[/b][/size]
[size=3]The tasks page provides a checklist for you to keep track of daily tasks. Tasks can be marked as completed by pressing the checkbox on the left-hand side, or you can choose from various auto-completion conditions that will automatically track your progress - these are categorized into [i]task types[/i].[/size]

[size=3]Task types can be applied automatically to "well-formed" task names that use the relevant keywords, and enough supplementary information (item/villager/building names), to create a task. Additionally, the task options menu can be used to fine-tune the task settings directly. Either click the wrench icon in the add task menu or click the name of an existing task to open the options menu.[/size]

[size=3]At the end of each day, all completed tasks are removed unless given a [i]renewal period[/i]. Choose between daily, weekly, monthly, annual, and [i]custom[/i] renewals to automatically reactivate tasks after completion. A custom renewal period allows you to set the number of days to wait [i]after task completion[/i]. Renewal periods must be set via the options menu.[/size]

[size=3]To help with organization, tasks can be grouped under a [i]header[/i]. In the options menu for a task, select the "Header" button to the right of the "Name" textbox and it will transform the task into a header. All tasks under the header will be grouped together when sorting and will share the same color (by default).[/size]

[size=3]A brief explanation of each task type, and configuration options, can be found on the [url=https://github.com/MolsonCAD/DeluxeJournal#task-types]Deluxe Journal GitHub page[/url].[/size]

[size=3]Tips:[/size][list]
[*][size=3][i]Shortcuts[/i]: ﻿Press the spacebar while on the tasks page to quickly open the "Add Task" menu.[/size]
[*][size=3][i]Task Order[/i]: Click and drag to reorder tasks. Completed and inactive (waiting for renewal) tasks will always be grouped at the end of the task list/header group for readability.[/size] 
[*][size=3][i]Money Box[/i]: Pressing the "G" symbol on the money box will toggle between "total amount to pay/gain" and "net wealth."[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Notes Page[/b][/size]
[size=3]The notes page provides a section for writing down anything beyond the scope of a task. Changes to the notes are saved automatically and persist even if the day is reset or you quit the game.[/size]

[size=3][i]The gamepad is not currently supported for editing the notes.[/i][/size]

[size=3][b]Overlays Page[/b][/size]
[size=3]The overlays page is the control center for managing on-screen overlays. The top section includes shared settings for all overlays and below it is the list of available page overlays. The hotkey toggles [i]unlocked[/i] overlays between visible/hidden and the background color edits the background for all overlays.[/size]

[size=3]The overlays list includes settings for each available on-screen page overlay. The [i]visibility checkbox[/i] shows/hides the overlay, the [i]visibility lock[/i] enables/disables toggling the overlay visibility using the hotkey, and the color picker allows customizing the overlay text color.[/size]

[size=3]The "Edit-Mode" button at the bottom of the page activates edit-mode, which allows repositioning and resizing any [i]visible[/i] overlays. Press the "Cancel" button or the ESC key to exit edit-mode. All changes are saved instantly.[/size]

[size=3][i]All overlay settings are stored globally and independently from any game save and will be shared for all saves.[/i][/size]

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26194]QuickSave (Save Midday)[/url] - fully supported. Tasks and overlays correctly save and restore state on quickload.[/size]
[/list][size=4][b][u]SEE ALSO[/u][/b][/size]
